Official syllabus, subject by subject (Education Recruitment Board, 2022)

The board published a separate syllabus for each subject of the 4161-post round. The papers are at graduation level in the subject.

SubjectWhat the official syllabus covers
MathematicsSets, matrices and determinants, complex numbers, permutations, binomial theorem, sequences, conic sections, 3-D geometry, limits, continuity, derivatives and integrals, differential equations, linear programming, probability, statistics, number theory, numerical analysis, statics and dynamics
SciencePhysical, inorganic and organic chemistry; physics; botany and zoology (cell, genetics, DNA, biodiversity, ecology); and the mathematics topics above
Social ScienceHistory (Rig Vedic age to modern India), geography of India with special reference to Punjab, civics (Parliament, President, courts, fundamental rights, UNO), economics
EnglishIndian English writers; English literature from the Elizabethan to the contemporary period; literary terms; grammar and linguistics (graduation level)
Punjabi / HindiLanguage, grammar and literature of the subject (see the PDF)
DPE (Physical Education)Physical fitness, methods of training, warm-up and cool-down, and the rest of the DPE syllabus

Frequently asked questions

Which subjects were in the 4161 Master Cadre recruitment?

Mathematics, Science, English, Punjabi, Hindi and Social Science, filled through the Education Recruitment Board, Punjab.
